Checkmarx March 2026 GitHub Actions and OpenVSX compromise

Target: checkmarx-march-2026 · repo
Date: 2026-03-23
Actor: Advanced Persistent Threat (group)
Target Kind: ci_cd_plugin
Language: Shell
Cause: compromised_account_credentials
Motive: credential_theft
Transitive: true
Impact: credential_theft
User Impact: 0
Phase: ci_cd

Synopsis

TeamPCP turned Checkmarx's own developer tooling into a credential-harvesting path on March 23, 2026. Malicious GitHub Action tags and OpenVSX extensions reached CI runners and developer workstations, collecting environment variables, cloud keys, SSH material, Kubernetes tokens, and Checkmarx credentials before exfiltration to attacker infrastructure. The incident mattered because security scanners and IDE plugins sit directly inside privileged build and development workflows.
